en: The Pokémon League is where Trainers seek strength and show it. To show it, you need only defeat the Elite Four and then the Champion.
Challenge the Elite Four in any order you like. Beat all four, and the Champion's way opens.
But hear me: once you go in, there's no turning back. You battle until you have beaten them all, or been beaten yourself.
Are you ready to go in?
Don't skimp on getting ready. The Pokémon Center is just there. Heal your Pokémon and come back.
Once you go in, you battle until you have beaten them all, or been beaten yourself.
The Pokémon League is the greatest challenge a Trainer can take on!
Get ready here first. Lose even once inside, and you start all over again.
